intro.title: Tile & Stone Services
intro.mainText: Tile and stone are some of the most durable and visually impactful finishes for modern interiors. VV Renovation installs tile and stone surfaces with precision, creating clean, long-lasting results for residential and commercial spaces.
intro.secondaryText: We work with homeowners, designers and builders across the Greater Vancouver Area to deliver high-quality tile and stone installation tailored to each project.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: We discuss your project, materials, layout, design goals and recommend the right tile or stone solution.

steps.title: Surface Preparation
steps.text: Our team prepares the substrate carefully to ensure proper leveling, adhesion and long-term durability.

steps.title: Installation
steps.text: We install tile or stone with precision, paying close attention to alignment, spacing, cuts and finishing details.

steps.title: Grouting & Final Finishing
steps.text: We complete grouting, sealing where required, and leave the finished space clean, polished and ready to use.

items.question: What tile and stone services do you provide?
items.answer: We install tile and stone for bathrooms, kitchens, backsplashes, floors, and custom interior finishes for residential and commercial spaces.

items.question: Do you install tile in bathrooms and showers?
items.answer: Yes, we specialize in bathroom tile installation including showers, walls, floors, and full bathroom finishes.

items.question: How long does tile installation take?
items.answer: The timeline depends on the size and complexity of the project. Most tile installations take a few days, including preparation, installation, and finishing.

items.question: Do you prepare surfaces before installing tile?
items.answer: Yes, we properly prepare and level surfaces to ensure strong adhesion, durability, and a clean, professional finish.

items.question: Do you work with custom layouts and designs?
items.answer: Absolutely. We work with custom layouts, patterns, and design ideas to create unique and visually appealing tile and stone finishes.

items.question: Do you provide services across the Greater Vancouver Area?
items.answer: Yes, we provide flooring installation services across Vancouver and surrounding areas including Burnaby, Richmond, Surrey, New Westminster, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, Maple Ridge, Pitt Meadows, White Rock, North Vancouver (City), North Vancouver (District), West Vancouver, Delta, Langley (City), Langley (Township).
